# Story 01 — Customer notes on the web (Story: CRM-61)

## Prerequisites

- **CUSTOMERS-1-API
completed** — this story consumes the existing `GET /customers/:id/notes` and `POST /customers/:id/notes` routes registered in
`api/src/features/customers/customers.routes.js:26,35`. No `api/` changes are permitted (out-of-scope per intake).

- **`web/` package only.** Commands run from `web/` with `npm`.
- Coordinate wording with the shared error

map so the new domain codes surface through `t.errors[...]`.

---

## Story Goal

Give an agent, from a customer's scre

en, the ability to **read the customer's internal notes** and **write a new one**, so that:

1. Writing a val

id note makes it appear in the list **without reloading the whole screen** (the POST reply is appended to the in-memory list; the GET does not fire a second time).
2. Submitting a blank or

whitespace-only note is refused **on the field** with the same wording the API would return — the request is not sent.
3. Every note sh
ows **who wrote it** and **when**, with the timestamp rendered in the reader's locale (BR-3) and the author id resolved to a human-

readable label (`author_id === null` reads as "System", not blank) (BR-2).
4. Every vis

ible string comes from `en.ts` and `ar.ts`, added in the same edit so `parity.test.ts` stays green (BR-6).

**

Out of scope:** editing/deleting a note, notes on a ticket/conversation, any change under `api/`.

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1
. `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.tsx` — the current customers screen. Read the wh
ole file (~161 lines). Follow the four-state layout driven by `useCustomerSearch`, the `Field` + `Button` submit p
attern (lines 59–85), the `busy / error / empty / success` branches (lines 89–158), and the `t.errors[error

.code as keyof typeof t.errors] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL` error mapping at line 98. Match tone and structure.
2. `web/src/pages/
customers/useCustomerSearch.ts` — the reference hook shape (state machine returning `{ status, page, error, query, search }`). New

note hooks should look the same.
3. `web/src/pages/tickets/TicketQueuePage.tsx` — reference for a list-plus-write layout inside one

page. Grep the file for `useRequest` and how the mutation result is folded back into the visible list without a re-fetch.
4. `web/src/pages/tickets/useChangeSt
atus.ts` and `web/src/pages/tickets/useAssignTicket.ts` — the precedent for a **single-mutation hook** returning `{ status, error, run }`. Copy

the shape; do not invent a new one.
5. `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — the four-state hook. Confirm its exported type before

wiring it.
6. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` and `web/src/shared/api/base-url.ts` — the request wrapper. **`request(path)` already prefixes `/api/v1`

** (`base-url.ts:3`); call `request('/customers/:id/notes')`, never `'/api/v1/...'` (CRM-72 defect).
7. `web/src/shared/api/errors.ts` — how API

error codes surface. Notes must render via `t.errors[error.code]` and never compose from `fields`.
8. `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared

/i18n/ar.ts` — add every new key in **both**. `parity.test.ts` fails on divergence.
9. `web/src/shared/i18n/useFormatters.ts` and
`web/src/shared/i18n/format.ts` — the locale-aware formatters. The note timestamp comes from `useFormatters` (BR-3);

do not render the raw ISO string.
10. `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` — confirm the primitives available (`Button, Card, EmptyState,
ErrorState, Field, Heading, Input, Select, Skeleton, Stack, Text, TextArea`). `Field` accepts a render prop so it can wrap a `TextArea` while keeping the same label + error sl

ot.
11. `web/src/app/routes.tsx` (lines 7 and 33–37) — the current `/customers` route mounts `CustomersPage`; add a **child route** for

`/customers/:id` that mounts the new detail page.
12. `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx` — vitest + Testing Library conventions for this fe
ature. Match the `render` helper import from `../../testing/render` and the fetch-stub shape used for `pageOf(...

)` responses.
13. `web/src/pages/tickets/AssignTicket.test.tsx` and `web/src/pages/tickets/ResolveTicket.test.tsx` — the precedents for testing a mutation hook + form
. **Every fetch stub call must return a fresh `Response`** (L-30 in `.squad/plan-lessons.md`); a sh

ared body reads once and the test times out.
14. `api/src/features/customers/customers.routes.js` (lines 23–42) — read to confirm route pa

ths and payload shape (`{ body }`) and the `201` reply. Do not modify.
15. `api/src/features/customers/customers.service.js` — grep for `listNotes`
and `writeNote` and confirm the DTO the routes return. **Say what you find** in the note DTO (does it already include the author
's name, or only `author_id`?). If names are absent, resolve the id on the client the same way CRM-77 solved assignees; if

they are present, use them directly.
16. `api/src/platform/db/migrations/0006__customer_notes.sql` (line 24 area) — confirm `body TEXT NOT NULL` and the rules-

layer's whitespace rejection reasoning; this is the second guard behind the client's own pre-submit check.
17. `.squad/plan-lessons.md` — read
once end-to-end; obey L-30 (fresh Response per fetch stub), the "no hardcoded strings, including separators typ

ed between tags" rule, and the `useRequest` / four-state discipline.
18. `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/par

ity.test.ts` — the tests that will catch a missed key.

---

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current behaviour:** there is no customer detail screen; not

es are neither readable nor writable from the web.
- **New behaviour:** a customer's detail page lists internal notes newest-first and lets the agent write one; the created note is
appended in place; whitespace-only input is refused before the request; every string is translated; the author and time are always

visible; system-written notes read as "System" rather than blank.

---

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Route the customer detail page

**

File:** `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

Add a route below the existing `/customers` route (currently at line 33): `path="/customers/:id"` that mounts a new `CustomerDet
ailPage`. Import from `../pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage`. Wrap in the same `RequireAuth` / `DeskShell` compos

ition already used for `/customers`. Keep the existing `/customers` route untouched.

### 2 — Create the notes-list hook

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerNotes.ts`

Model

on `useCustomerSearch.ts`. Export a `Note` type plus a hook that returns `{ status, notes, error, load, append }`:

- `load(customerId)` → `request
(\`/customers/${customerId}/notes\`)`; on success stores `page.items` sorted newest-first (or in the order

the API returned).
- `append(note)` → prepends the note the POST returned to the in-memory list. **No re-fetch.**
-

Wraps the request in `useRequest` so consumers get the same four-state contract as the rest of the app.

Do **not** call `/api/v1/...` — `request` already prefixes

it.

### 3 — Create the write-note hook

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/customers/useWriteCustomerNote.ts`

Model on `web/src/pages/tickets/useAssignTicket.ts`. Export `{ status, error,

run }` where `run(customerId, body)`:

1. **Pre-checks `body.trim().length > 0`.** If empty, resolves with `{ ok: false, code: '
BODY_REQUIRED' }` (or the exact code the API uses — confirm via grep against `customers.service.js` / rules) **without calling `request

`**. The API's rules layer refuses the same input, so the round-trip is wasted.
2. Otherwise `POST /customers/:id/notes` with `{ body: body.trim() }` and returns the created note from the

201 response.

### 4 — Build the detail page

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage.tsx`

Structure (follow `CustomersPage.tsx` for

tone and `TicketQueuePage.tsx` for a list-plus-form layout):

- `useParams<{ id: string }>()` to read the customer id.
- `useT

ranslation()`, `useFormatters()`.
- `useCustomerNotes()` + `useWriteCustomerNote()`.
- `useEffect` to `load(id)` on mount, mirroring `CustomersPage.tsx`'

s first-page pattern (lines 45–50).
- **Header:** `Heading level={2}` reading `t.customers.notes.title`.
- **Write form:** `Stack as
="form" onSubmit=...`. Uses `Field` with a render prop wrapping `TextArea` so the field label and in
line error come from the same primitive. Bind the field's error state to a local `fieldError` string translated from `t.errors[code]` (never composed from `fields`). Submit button
disabled while the write hook's status is `loading` or when `term.trim() === ''` is intentionally allowed to still show the field-level error on
submit rather than silently disabling — pick one and comment why. The precedent in `CustomersPage.tsx:79-84

` is to disable during `busy`; follow it for the submit action and rely on the pre-check for whitespace.
- **List

branches** (four states from `useCustomerNotes`):
  - `loading` → `Skeleton lines={3} height="72px" label={t.states

.loading}`.
  - `error` → `ErrorState title={t.customers.notes.errorTitle} body={t.errors[error.code] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL} onRetry={() => load(id)} retryLabel={t.states

.retry}`.
  - `success && notes.length === 0` → `EmptyState title={t.customers.notes.emptyTitle} body={t.customers.notes.emptyBody}` (no action button — writing one

is the same page).
  - `success && notes.length > 0` → `<ul>` of `<NoteRow>` items.

- **`NoteRow`** (local component):

renders
  - `Text` for the body (preserve line breaks via `white-space: pre-wrap` in CSS).
  - `Text variant="muted"` for the me

ta line: author label + formatted time.
    - **Author label:** if the DTO already includes a resolved name, render it. Otherwise use `t.customers.notes.systemAuthor` (`
"System" / "النظام"`) when `author_id === null`, and fall back to a client-side resolver when non-null (mirror CRM-77's assignees pattern; **do not**

fetch per row).
    - **Time:** `useFormatters().dateTime(note.created_at)` — never render the raw UTC string (BR-3).

**On
successful write:** call `append(createdNote)`, then reset the form's local state. **Do not** call `load(id)` again — a test will count the requests and fail if

a second GET fires (this is the "with teeth" criterion).

### 5 — CSS

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage.css`

Small
, following `CustomersPage.css`. At minimum: `.customer-notes` list reset, `.customer-notes__row` spacing, `white-space: pre-wrap` on the body text.

Import from the page component only.

### 6 — Add the translation keys

**Files:** `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` **and** `web/src/shared/i18

n/ar.ts` — add in the **same edit**.

Add under `customers`:

```ts
notes: {
  title: 'Internal notes',            // AR:

'ملاحظات داخلية'
  writeLabel: 'New note',             // AR: 'ملاحظة جديدة'
  writePlaceholder: 'Write a note visible only

to your team',
  submit: 'Add note',
  submitting: 'Adding…',
  emptyTitle: 'No notes yet',
  emptyBody: 'The

first note about this customer will show up here.',
  errorTitle: 'Could not load notes',
  systemAuthor: 'System',
  authorAndTime: '{author
} · {time}',  // used only if you interpolate; otherwise omit and compose via <Is
olated>/spacing in CSS, never a hardcoded separator in JSX (see no-hardcoded-

strings.test.ts)
},
```

Add the domain error codes the API returns for note writes into `t.errors` in **both** files (e.g. `BODY_REQUIRED`
, `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` — confirm against `customers.service.js`). **Never** compose sentences from `error.fields`; look up by code with the `INTERNAL` fallback used

on `CustomersPage.tsx:98`.

**Formatting reminder (BR-6):** any separator character between JSX tags (`·`, `—`, `,`) is a literal and
will trip `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`. Either move the separator inside a translated composite string or express it via CSS `

::before`/`gap`. Read the test's rule first.

---

## No API changes

`api/`
is untouched. `GET /customers/:id/notes` and `POST /customers/:id/notes` already exist (`api/src/features/customers/customers.routes.js:26,35`) and the schema constra

int on `body` is already `TEXT NOT NULL` (`api/src/platform/db/migrations/0006__customer_notes.sql:24`).

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Whitespace-only body.**
Trigger: agent types spaces/newlines and presses submit. Expected: request is **not** sent; the field renders the same message the API would have (
`t.errors.BODY_REQUIRED` or the canonical code). Enforced in the pre-check in `useWriteCustomerNote.ts` (task 3) and doubled by the API's rules layer.
- **Duplicate submits.** Trigger: agent clicks Submit twice. Expected: the submit button is `disabled` while the mutation hook status is `loading`, matching `CustomersP

age.tsx:79-84`. Confirmed by the same test that counts POSTs.
- **Successful write.** Expected: only **one** POST fires and **

no second GET**. Enforced by `append(createdNote)` in the write handler (task 4).
- **`author_id === null`.** Expected: the row reads `t.customers.

notes.systemAuthor`, never a blank. Enforced in `NoteRow`.
- **Non-null `author_id` with no name in the DTO.** Expected: resolve on the client (CRM-77 pattern
), not one fetch per row. **Uncertainty:** confirm whether the API DTO already carries an author display name by grepping `customers.service.js
` for `author` and `name`. If it does, use it directly; if not, add a single lookup (batched or from the ass

ignees list). Document what you found in the PR description.
- **Unicode / RTL content.** Trigger: an agent writes an Arabic note. Expected: the body ren
ders correctly in an RTL paragraph. Follow the `Isolated` pattern from `CustomersPage.tsx:29,32` if

the meta line mixes LTR ids with RTL text.
- **API error on load.** Trigger: server returns 500. Expected: the error branch shows `t.errors[error

.code] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL` with a Retry button that calls `load(id)` again.
- **Unknown / new error code from the API

.** Expected: falls back to `t.errors.INTERNAL`. Never derive a sentence from `error.fields`.
- **Timestamp rendering.** Trigger: reader switches language

. Expected: `useFormatters().dateTime` re-renders in the new locale. Enforced in `NoteRow`.
- **Concurrent notes.** Trigger:
another agent writes a note between load and write. Expected: the appended list may not include the other agent's note until the page is reopened;

acceptable — no polling is in scope.

---

## Test Plan

Use `vitest` + Testing Library, `render` from `web/src/testing/render.tsx`. Foll
ow patterns in `web/src/pages/tickets/AssignTicket.test.tsx` and `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx`. **Every fetch stub returns a fresh `Response` per

call** (L-30).

1. **`web/src/pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage.test.tsx`** (new):
   1. Renders the loading skeleton, then the list of notes retur

ned by `GET /customers/:id/notes`, showing author and locale-formatted time for each row.
   2. Whitespace-only input on submit shows the field-level error and **does not** call `fetch`

for the POST (assert `mockFetch` was only called for the initial GET).
   3. A valid submit calls `POST /customers/:id/notes` **once**, prepends the returned note to the list, and cl

ears the textarea. **Asserts exactly one GET total** (no re-fetch after the write) — this is the "with teeth" criterion.
   4. When the PO
ST responds with a domain error (e.g. `BODY_REQUIRED`, `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND`), the field shows the mapped `t.errors[code]` copy, not

a raw code, and no note is appended.
   5. When `author_id === null` on a returned note, the meta line reads the `systemAuthor`

translation, not an empty span.
   6. Language switch re-renders the timestamp using the new locale's formatter (small assertion via `useFormat

ters`).
2. **`web/src/pages/customers/useWriteCustomerNote.test.ts`** (new): unit-tests the pre-check (whitespace returns the

domain error without calling `request`) and the trimming behaviour.
3. **`web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerNotes.test.ts`** (new): unit-tests `load` state

transitions and `append` prepending semantics without side effects.
4. **`web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts`** — must continue to pass after adding keys in both `en.ts` and `ar.

ts`.
5. **`web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`** — must continue to pass. Watch separators between JSX tags in `NoteRow`.
6. **`

web/src/app/routing.test.tsx`** — extend to cover the `/customers/:id` route mounting `CustomerDetailPage`.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend tests

:** `cd web && npm test` — the new suites and `parity.test.ts` / `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` all pass.
2. **Frontend build:** `cd web && npm run
build` (`tsc -b && vite build`) — succeeds. The web suite does not typecheck under `npm test`, so this step is the one

that catches TS regressions.
3. **Backend regression (should be a no-op):** `cd api && npm test` — passes unchanged;

confirms no `api/` file was touched.
4. **No AI attribution regression:** `grep -Ri --exclude-dir=node_modules -e 'cop
ilot' -e 'chatgpt' -e 'claude' -e 'openai' -e 'anthropic' web/ api/` returns nothing new. Also run `cd api && npm test -

- no-ai-attribution` if the test runs from that suite.
5. **Regression: request prefix.** Grep the new

files for `/api/v1` — must return zero matches. `request()` already prefixes it.
6. **Regression: fresh Response per stub.** Grep the new test files for `m

ockFetch.mockResolvedValue(` (single value) — every fetch stub must use `mockResolvedValueOnce` or a factory that builds a new `Response` each call (L-30).
7. **Manual smoke:** `c
d web && npm run dev`, sign in, navigate to `/customers/<id>` for a seeded customer, write a note in English and Arabic, verify the note appears without the list fl

ickering, verify blank submit shows the field error, verify system-authored notes read "System" / "النظام".

---

write one, using only shared primitives from `web/src/shared/ui/`.
- [ ] Submitting a valid note appends the new note to the visible list; the network log shows **

with the field-level error copy mapped from the API's canonical code via `t.errors` (verified by test 1.2).
- [ ] Every note row shows the author (fal

ling back to the `systemAuthor` translation when `author_id === null`) and a timestamp rendered through `useFormatters` (BR-2, BR-3).
- [ ] All

- [ ] `cd web && npm test` and `cd web && np

m run build` both pass; `cd api && npm test` still passes with no `api/` file modified.
- [ ] No new files reference `/api/v1` (`request()` prefixes it) and no fetch stub re
uses a `Response` across calls (L-30).
